newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Coles not keen on wholesaling, petrol.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Coles not keen on wholesaling, petrol.

text.p: Australian retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Thursday it did not plan to expand into the wholesaling business and also expressed no interest in selling petrol from its supermarket sites.
Coles was moving toward wholesaling about two years ago but is now concentrating on improving its core businesses, chief executive Dennis Eck told reporters in Melbourne.
"We made the decision that we would be far better to focus on the core business and focus on fixing the supermarkets, rather than getting our mind off on another venture," he said.
He suggested Coles was also not interested in petrol retailing for the same reason, though rival supermarket chain Woolworths Ltd has begun to sell petrol.
"We have taken a quick look at that," Eck said. "We haven't been able to come to a critical mass on that...," he added.
Coles' supermarket division was focused instead on improving the range of produce it sells as well as service, he said.
Eck said Coles was exploring long-term opportunities in Asia but stressed no offshore expansion was imminent.
"We have been investigating options that exist offshore. A number of our people have been in and out of various places in Asia to make sure we understand that (market)," he said.
